Auto-generated shell tools

Several web and command-line helpers can generate bind- and reverse-shell payloads for different interpreters and operating systems:

  • reverse-shell.sh and revshells.com provide browser-based payload generators.[1][2]
  • Shellerator, ShellPop, ShellReverse, Reverse Shell Generator, revshellgen, and rsg generate payloads from the command line or a local interface.[3][4][5][8][9][10]
  • xc is a small cross-platform reverse shell for Linux and Windows.[7]
  • pyminifier is not a shell generator, but can minify or obfuscate Python payloads when that transformation is useful.[6]
